correctness.rationale: The stated population cumulants follow from the compound-Poisson exponential log-mgf plus independent zero-mean Gaussian clock error. With x_i=1/beta_i and w_i=m alpha_i x_i^3 the normalized third through fifth cumulants give a positive two-atom distribution of mass c, mean mu and variance v. Positivity and node distinction yield the exhaustive one-dimensional d in (0,mu) representation. The submitted rational S1 and S2 have strictly positive derivatives (independently differentiated symbolically) and boundary values c/mu and c/mu^2, so strictly positive m and clock variance cut out exactly (0,d*). k6=720c[mu^3+3mu v+v(v/d-d)] has strictly negative derivative and invertible range (K6*,infinity); this proves the exact compatibility, sharp open noise-variance interval and six-cumulant identification up to zone swapping. Independent exact-rational example and four node families checked; no extrapolation from those finite cases is used. The Gaussian is zero mean and dispersion absent; finite-sample data do not inherit exact identification.
residual_risks: Ideal two exponential storage rates with positive captures, positive deterministic mobile time, independent zero-mean Gaussian timing error and no dispersion; population cumulants only.
Earlier abstract-only generalized memory-function work could subsume special case.
Sixth cumulants from real measurements are unstable; no statistical consistency theorem.
